items.comparator: Compared with the company’s previously announced September milestone of 1 billion data points; no operating-performance comparison stated.
items.quantitative_outcome: Ainos said its AI Nose platform had accumulated “more than 3 billion real-world chemical data points,” “more than tripling” the 1 billion milestone announced in September. No measured workflow, throughput, accuracy, or cost benefit was stated.

items.quantitative_outcome: The ACCESS Newswire article states that, in a specialty-chemicals project, the company “improved production yield from 72% to nearly 90%.” It also reports a separate reaction-selectivity result rising “from 51.82% to 85% in three months,” and says screening 20 candidate molecules in two weeks “improved active ingredient retention rates by 20% across the board.”
items.signal: An AI-and-autonomous-lab workflow is reported to have improved specialty-chemical yield. The article does not identify the client, specify the exact comparison conditions, or provide independent validation, so the result is a weak, vendor-reported signal rather than established competitive advantage.
items.source: ACCESS Newswire article republished by Yahoo Finance

This is a measured early-stage discovery-quality signal, though the cited peer-reviewed study was published in July 2026, outside the 30-day window; the October event is the award announcement.
